title: Accessible E-Commerce Overhaul
description: A deep dive case study analyzing the accessibility transformations made to a global retail platform.

images.alt: Screenshot of the original checkout menu lacking keyboard focus rings and visible text labels.
The redesigned checkout page displaying high-contrast text and a clear keyboard focus indicator around the active input field.

htmlContent:
Our primary objective was achieving full WCAG AA compliance across the shopping experience.

Initial Accessibility Audit

We discovered critical drop-offs because users navigating strictly via screen readers or keyboards could not bypass the global navigation header.

Implementing a semantic skip-link architecture saved users an average of 42 keystrokes per page change.
